title: Deeper/broader peer artifact and version-capability matrix refresh
mode: primary-source artifact and peer-documentation research only
scope: Reconcile ACadSharp source release and NuGet artifact route/version claims
Refresh ACadRust documentation version and distinguish ACIS from optional foreign-format import
Reconfirm dwg-rs route maturity and implementation-lineage caveats
Refine existing composed comparator checkpoint without slowing local implementation slices

method.kind: Read-only review of tagged release pages, package metadata, docs.rs, current project documentation, and local plan
method.limitations: Version-operation tables and feature lists are project/package declarations, not reproduced parser/writer behavior, native CAD acceptance, complete graph preservation, or semantic 3D evidence. The NuGet binary and peer source were not downloaded, hashed, or run.

sources.revision: signed v3.8.0 release tag at commit 3a1c66b; reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: Release dated 2026-09-21; listed change is InternalsVisibleTo for ACadSharp.Formats. This identifies source release provenance, not format behavior.

Package metadata declares DXF read-only at AC1009; DXF read/write AC1012 through AC1032; DWG read/write at AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032; DWG read-only at AC1021; no DWG route listed at AC1009/AC1012. No runtime was executed and no package checksum was captured.

The docs.rs crate version now matches the current GitHub release version, superseding the previously recorded 0.5.5 docs.rs lag. It advertises broad DXF/DWG versions, 48 top-level entity variants, ACIS/SAT/SAB parsing/writing, and an optional import feature for STL, COLLADA, OBJ, glTF/GLB, and FBX. These are documentation claims, not independent semantic results.
Used only to reconcile exact release identity with current docs.rs version. CADCraft/OpenCADStudio and wrappers remain correlated through the ACadRust codec lineage.

sources.revision: mutable README and capability documentation reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The project describes pre-alpha DWG reading, partial entity/graph decoding, alpha DXF writing without a DXF parser, alpha DWG assembly without automated external-CAD acceptance, and approximate glTF surface output. It states that an LZ77 interpretation was cross-checked against ACadSharp algorithm comments.
Existing peer matrix and scheduled composed comparator checkpoints were refined; no local issue or implementation finding was added.

assessment.comparatorRule: Bind an exact artifact/package hash, source revision, runtime/toolchain, file version, and operation. Treat advertised-but-unexecuted capabilities as NOT_ESTABLISHED; unsupported advertised operations as NOT_ADVERTISED, not local failures.
assessment.peerLineage: ACadRust, CADCraft, OpenCADStudio and bindings remain one codec lineage. dwg-rs remains a distinct but pre-alpha DWG structural route; its disclosed ACadSharp-comment cross-check reduces independence for that specific algorithm question.
assessment.localCrosswalk: Reuse the existing composed peer checkpoint and version/operation matrix. Keep local fast implementation selectors, fixture policy, 2D consumer compatibility, 3D semantic evidence, and deferred external qualification unchanged.
assessment.implementationReadiness: At the composed checkpoint, only compare operation/version cells advertised by the selected peer. ACadSharp AC1021 DWG is reader-only; AC1009/AC1012 have no advertised DWG route; AC1009 DXF is reader-only. ACadRust 0.6.4 docs no longer lag the release, but documentation and internal round trips still cannot establish independent semantics.
